current_prompt.body:
RUN the First Fit algorithm on the items in the given arrival order [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] and REPORT the resulting packing.
FIND an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items and REPORT that packing.
CALCULATE the GAP between the number of bins used by First Fit and the optimal packing and REPORT the value.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins than the optimal solution.
INCLUDE a SELF‑TEST that VERIFIES both packings use all items exactly once and RESPECT the bin capacity constraint C = 10.

current_plan.body:
RUN First Fit algorithm on the items [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] with bin capacity 10 and RECORD the resulting packing.
COMPUTE an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items with capacity 10 and RECORD that packing.
CALCULATE the GAP as the difference between the number of bins used by First Fit and the optimal packing and RECORD the value.
EXPLAIN why the given arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins than the optimal solution.
SELF‑TEST that BOTH packings use all items exactly once and that every bin respects the capacity constraint C = 10.
